consume_seconds.description: The amount of seconds it takes for a player to consume the item. Defaults to 1.6.

animation.description: The animation used during consumption of the item. Must be one of {{cd|none|eat|drink|block|bow|spear|crossbow|spyglass|toot_horn|brush|d=or}}. Defaults to eat.

sound.description: {{json_ref|sound event|inline=1}} used during and on completion of the item's consumption. Defaults to entity.generic.eat.

has_consume_particles.description: Whether consumption particles are emitted while consuming this item. Defaults to true.

on_consume_effects.description: A list of effects which take place as a result of consuming this item. Optional.

type.description: The kind of consume effect. Must be one of {{cd|apply_effects|remove_effects|clear_all_effects|teleport_randomly|play_sound|d=or}}.

consumable.description: If present, this item can be consumed on use.

%effects-apply_effects.description: A list of [ [effect] ] instances applied once consumed.

amplifier.description: The amplifier of the effect, with level I having value 0. Optional, defaults to 0.

duration.description: The duration of the effect in [ [tick] ]s. Value -1 is treated as infinity. Values 0 or less than -2 are treated as 1. Optional, defaults to 1 tick.

ambient.description: Whether or not this is an effect provided by a beacon and therefore should be less intrusive on the screen. Optional, defaults to {{cd|false}}.

show_particles.description: Whether or not this effect produces particles. Optional, defaults to {{cd|true}}.

show_icon.description: Whether or not an icon should be shown for this effect. Optional, defaults to {{cd|true}}.

%effects-remove_effects.description: A set of effects removed once consumed, as either a single ID or list of IDs.
